title: Mohabbat
description: Shekhar falls for Roopa and visits her father with his family, but when his stepmother demands dowry, Roopa's father is insulted and decides to marry his daughter elsewhere, sparking conflict.

title: Chor Ke Ghar Chor
description: Rajkumari Ophelia hires a thug to steal a Devi Maa idol for luck, but the goddess's wrath awakens, bringing chaos and destruction to the lives of two noble families.

title: Fighter
description: Shamsher 'Patty' Pathania achieves his dream of joining the Indian Air Force. Facing intense trials and personal doubts, he must push his limits and prove himself as a true hero in the skies.

title: Trishul
description: Business tycoon Raj Kumar abandons Shanti, his first love, to marry a rich heiress. Later, Vijay, Raj and Shanti's illegitimate son, seeks revenge from Raj for the injustice meted out to his mother.

title: Baghban
description: An elderly couple wish their children to care for them in their old age. But their children see and treat them as a burden, and they must struggle to regain their worth and dignity.

title: Chennai Express
description: Rahul sets out to immerse his grandfather's ashes at Rameshwaram, but after helping runaway bride Meena board a train, he ends up clashing with her dangerous criminal family.

title: Inkaar
description: Rahul, a CEO, is accused of sexual harassment by his protege Maya. As an internal committee investigates, both are given a chance to present their sides, revealing hidden truths and motives.

title: Bumper Draw
description: Sunderlal and Farooq befriend each other in odd circumstances, but when they meet wealthy Pestonji, they hatch a cunning plan to use him to escape their money troubles.

title: Jug Jug Jeeyo
description: A family wedding becomes a backdrop for joy, romance, and celebration, but also exposes miscommunication, hidden affairs, and doubts that threaten to break marriages apart.

title: Chori Mera Kam
description: Bhola Nath, a petty thief and secretly Kumar's son, grows up amid crime. With Sharmii, he encounters rival gangsters, a bestselling manuscript, and dangerous secrets.

title: War
description: Kabir, a secret agent, goes rogue after a mission to catch a terrorist goes awry. However, his boss sends Khalid, another agent and his student, to track him down.

title: Welcome
description: Two thugs meet Rajiv, who belongs to a respectable family, and want to fix their sister's wedding with him. However, when Rajiv's uncle refuses to the match, a series of hilarious situations occur.

title: Dilwale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge
description: Raj, a rich, carefree, happy-go-lucky second generation NRI, follows Simran to India to win over her strict father and marry her.

title: Gabbar Is Back
description: After being wronged by the city's corrupt administration, Aditya adopts the alias Gabbar and joins hands with honest officers to wage a fearless war against corruption and injustice.
